title: Senior FullStack (Python) Engineer
raw_description:
Job Description
We are an Egyptian technology company delivering international software projects in cooperation with the global NIX brand. Our office in Smart Village, at the heart of Cairo's tech ecosystem, offers stability, transparent working conditions, professional mentorship, and a supportive team.
Responsibilities:
Designing the architecture of web applications and their components, defining data flows, dependencies, and communication between services
Developing both backend and frontend parts of web applications with a focus on scalability and maintainability
Decomposing project requirements into deliverable parts, estimating work, and planning development phases
Reviewing code and effort estimates of team members, mentoring engineers, and supporting their professional growth
Improving application performance, reducing technical debt, and driving refactoring initiatives
Discussing technical solutions, trade-offs, and risks directly with clients
What we offer:
Long-term career stability with a competitive salary paid in USD.
Conditions for steady career development.
Development supported by dedicated mentors and a variety of programs focused on expertise and innovation.
Private medical insurance provided after successful completion of the probationary period
A well-equipped and cozy office supports comfort and productivity across all project stages.
Welcoming atmosphere and a friendly corporate culture.

Job Requirements
What we expect from you:
5+ years of experience in commercial projects
Upper-Intermediate English level and strong communication skills to discuss technical solutions, trade-offs, and risks directly with clients
Excellent understanding of advanced Python and JavaScript (TypeScript) concepts, and strong experience building REST services with FastAPI, DRF, or Flask
Strong commercial experience with React or Vue
Deep knowledge of Relational Databases: query optimization, indexing, isolation levels and locking, and fixing ORM performance anti-patterns
Experience setting up CI/CD pipelines and containerization (Docker)
Hands-on experience with AWS, including serverless architectures (Lambda, API Gateway, Step Functions, EventBridge, DynamoDB, SQS/SNS) and container-based workloads (ECS/EKS), as well as RDS, S3, CloudWatch, and IAM
Experience designing and evolving system architecture, from monoliths to microservices, with a clear understanding of their trade-offs, service boundaries, integration patterns (REST, event-driven, message brokers such as RabbitMQ, Kafka, or AWS SQS/SNS), data consistency, and observability
Experience building high-performance applications: identifying and eliminating bottlenecks across API, database, and caching layers, and applying asynchronous processing and advanced caching
Defining testing strategy at the project level (unit / integration / e2e), keeping tests reliable and maintainable
Ability to decompose requirements, estimate effort, and identify dependencies and risks affecting scope, timeline, and resources
Experience mentoring engineers, conducting code reviews, and introducing engineering practices on the project level, including team guidelines for AI-assisted development (AI coding tools, reviewing AI-generated code, safe AI usage in client projects)
Experience with LLM API integration, RAG, MCP, and agentic workflows
Will be a plus:
Understanding of business models and product roadmaps, and participation in strategic technical discussions
Experience with Kubernetes and IaC tools (AWS CDK, Terraform, CloudFormation)
Experience with AI services on AWS (Amazon Bedrock, Bedrock AgentCore, SageMaker)
Experience with other cloud platforms (GCP or Azure)
Experience with frontend architecture: micro-frontends or modular frontend systems, and rendering/loading performance profiling
Experience with another backend language (Node.js, Go, or Java)
Open-minded attitude toward new technologies and approaches

title: Senior Python Developer
raw_description:
Job Description
We are looking for a
Senior Python Software Engineer
with
at least 4 years of professional experience
developing backend applications using Python to join our engineering team. In this role, you will help design, build, maintain, and evolve scalable backend services that power our platform.
You will be responsible for implementing high-quality software solutions, optimizing application performance, and contributing to the architecture and long-term evolution of our systems. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will participate in technical design discussions, mentor fellow engineers, and promote engineering best practices. This role requires deep technical expertise in Python, Django, distributed systems, and modern software engineering principles.

Job Requirements
Responsibilities
Design, develop, and implement new functionality for decoupled backend services.
Maintain, enhance, and refactor existing backend applications to improve scalability, reliability, and maintainability.
Analyze and optimize application performance, database queries, and overall system efficiency.
Take ownership of backend services throughout their lifecycle, including architecture, deployment, production support, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
Participate actively in technical design discussions, solution architecture, and project planning sessions.
Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and stakeholders to deliver high-quality software solutions.
Review code, provide constructive feedback, and champion engineering best practices through peer collaboration.
Mentor and support other team members by sharing technical expertise and assisting with complex engineering challenges.
Troubleshoot production issues using profiling, monitoring, logging, and diagnostic tools.
Produce and maintain clear technical documentation, architectural diagrams, and design specifications.
Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend improvements to the engineering stack where appropriate.
Effectively utilize AI-powered development tools (such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Codex) to accelerate software development while ensuring code quality, correctness, security, and maintainability.
Qualifications
At least 5 years of professional experience
developing backend applications with
Python
.
Strong commercial experience building web applications using
Django
and the Django ORM.
Solid experience working with relational databases, particularly
MySQL
.
Experience designing, developing, and consuming
RESTful APIs
,
GraphQL
, or similar service interfaces.
Experience working with distributed systems and asynchronous messaging technologies such as
Celery
.
Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, software design patterns, clean architecture, and distributed system design.
Experience using Git-based version control workflows, including branching strategies, pull requests, and code reviews.
Experience writing technical documentation and software design specifications.
Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization skills using profiling tools, SQL execution plans, application monitoring tools (e.g., New Relic), and related technologies.
Ability to work independently, take ownership of technical solutions, prioritize tasks effectively, and proactively resolve issues.
Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to participate in technical discussions and mentor other engineers.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with supporting technologies such as
Redis
,
Memcached
,
Elasticsearch
, and
Celery
.
Experience building, deploying, and operating cloud-native or highly scalable backend services.
Experience working within Agile/Scrum development environments.
Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Codex) for code generation, testing, debugging, refactoring, and code review while applying sound engineering judgment to validate and improve generated output.
Experience mentoring junior and mid-level engineers and contributing to engineering standards and best practices.

title: Cashier
raw_description:
80776BR

Job Description

Position Purpose:

Cashiers play a critical customer service role by providing customers with fast, friendly, accurate and safe service. They process Checkout and/or Return transactions, as well as monitor and maintain the Self-Checkout area. They proactively seek product/project knowledge to provide customers with information and identify selling opportunities. They follow all policies and procedures to ensure that shrink is minimized. A Head Cashier will position Cashiers and support them by expediting price checks, approving Point of Sale transactions and markdowns for mainline registers, Self-Checkout, Returns, Pro Desk, Special Services, and Tool Rental. They provide first level escalation for customer issues and assist in the supervision, coaching and training of other Front End Associates by participating in the training of new Cashiers and utilizing all available tools to coach and develop other Cashiers. The preferred qualification for a Head Cashier is 1+ years of Cashier experience.
